lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce4In4Bi4Sn4 (CeInBiSn) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all four elements adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom; Ce and Sn each coordinate to 4 Bi, 4 In, and 4 of the other element, while Bi and In each coordinate to 8 Ce and 4 Sn. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Ce and Sn 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Bi and In polyhedra.
